# Comparing our linked genes with Ethan's list of prioritized genes

## load genes with nonzero scores
```{r}
library(data.table)
library(rtracklayer)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
ch=import.chain("data/hg19ToHg38.over.chain")
aoa <- read.table("data/aoa_gene_scores.txt", header = T)
coa <- read.table("data/coa_gene_scores.txt", header = T)
gr_peaks_sub <- readRDS("data/asthma_related_CREs_final43.RDS")
pal_atac <- readRDS("data/color_codes.RDS")
names(pal_atac)[3] <- "memCD4_T"
```

```{r}
multiome_tbl <- readRDS("output/scE2G/scE2G_p2g_significant_links.RDS")
p2g_summary <- p2g_tbl %>%
  mutate(Gene = unlist(lapply(p2g_tbl$cutLabel, function(i){strsplit(i, "_")[[1]][2]})),
         trait = gr_peaks_p2g$trait[match(Peak, gr_peaks_p2g$Peak)],
    GeneScore = ifelse(trait == "aoa", aoa$Score[match(Gene, aoa$Gene)], coa$Score[match(Gene, coa$Gene)]))

p2g_gr <- 
  p2g_summary %>% dplyr::select(c(Peak, GeneScore, Gene)) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    group_by(Peak) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(linkedGene = paste(Gene, collapse = ","),
                     GeneScore = paste(GeneScore, collapse = ","))

p2g_gr <- GRanges(p2g_gr$Peak,
                  LinkedGene = p2g_gr$linkedGene,
                  GeneScore = p2g_gr$GeneScore,
                  Peak = p2g_gr$Peak)
```
load Ethan's list of CREs
```{r}
aoa <- fread("~/projects/Lung_scMultiomics_paper/data/aoa_ePIPs.txt")
coa <- fread("~/projects/Lung_scMultiomics_paper/data/coa_ePIPs.txt")

aoa_scores <- read.table("../data/aoa_gene_scores.txt", header = T)
coa_scores <- read.table("../data/coa_gene_scores.txt", header = T)
gene_scores <- 
  rbind(data.frame(aoa_scores, Trait = "aoa"),
        data.frame(coa_scores, Trait = "coa"))

```

```{r}
cre_gr <- c(GRanges(data.frame(trait = "aoa", aoa)), 
               GRanges(data.frame(trait = "coa", coa)))
seqlevelsStyle(cre_gr) <- "UCSC"
cre_gr <- unlist(liftOver(cre_gr, ch))

nominated_genes <- mcols(cre_gr[, grep("gene", colnames(mcols(cre_gr)))])

cre_gr$combined <- 
  apply(nominated_genes[, -2], 1, function(i){
    paste(i[i!=""], collapse = ",")
  })
cre_gr$nominated <-
  unlist(apply(mcols(cre_gr)[, c("combined", "trait")], 1, function(i){
    scores = gene_scores[gene_scores$Trait == i[2], ]
    gene_sets = strsplit(i[1], ",")[[1]]
    idx = which(scores$Score[match(gene_sets, scores$Gene)] >= 0.95)
    return(paste(unique(gene_sets[idx]), collapse = ","))
  }))
```
load fine-mapped SNPs
```{r}
coa <- readRDS("data/coa_gp3_finemapping_gwas_L5.rds")
aoa <- readRDS("data/aoa_gp3_finemapping_gwas_L5.rds")

aoa_gr <- GRanges(seqnames = paste0("chr", aoa$chr),
                IRanges(start = aoa$pos,
                        end = aoa$pos+1))
mcols(aoa_gr) <- data.frame(aoa[, -4:-1], trait = "aoa")
coa_gr <- GRanges(seqnames = paste0("chr", coa$chr),
                IRanges(start = coa$pos,
                        end = coa$pos+1))
mcols(coa_gr) <- data.frame(coa[, -4:-1], trait = "coa")
merge_gr <- c(coa_gr, aoa_gr)
#liftOver to hg38
ch=import.chain("data/hg19ToHg38.over.chain")
seqlevelsStyle(merge_gr) <- "UCSC"
snp_gr <- unlist(liftOver(merge_gr, ch))
```


```{r}
print("CREs in Ethan's list")
paired <- findOverlaps(p2g_gr, cre_gr)
p2g_gr$NewCREs <- FALSE
p2g_gr$NewCREs[setdiff(1:length(p2g_gr), paired@from)] <- TRUE
p2g_gr$CandidateGenes <- ""
p2g_gr$CandidateGenes[paired@from] <- cre_gr$nominated[paired@to]
#find all fine-mapped SNPs in CREs
aoa_peaks <- gr_peaks_sub[gr_peaks_sub$trait == "aoa"]
aoa_snps <- snp_gr[snp_gr$trait == "aoa" & snp_gr$susie_pip > 0.1]
aoa_paired <- findOverlaps(aoa_peaks + 250, aoa_snps)
coa_peaks <- gr_peaks_sub[gr_peaks_sub$trait == "coa"]
coa_snps <- snp_gr[snp_gr$trait == "coa" & snp_gr$susie_pip > 0.1]
coa_paired <- findOverlaps(coa_peaks + 250, coa_snps)

tbl <- rbind(
data.frame(aoa_paired, trait = "aoa") %>% 
  mutate(snp_pip = aoa_snps$susie_pip[subjectHits],
         snp = aoa_snps$snp[subjectHits]) %>%
    group_by(queryHits, trait) %>% 
      dplyr::summarise(susie_pips = paste(round(snp_pip, 2), collapse = ","),
                       snps = paste(snp, collapse = ",")) %>%
  mutate(Peak = aoa_peaks$Peak[queryHits]),
data.frame(coa_paired, trait = "coa") %>% 
  mutate(snp_pip = coa_snps$susie_pip[subjectHits],
         snp = coa_snps$snp[subjectHits]) %>%
    group_by(queryHits, trait) %>% 
      dplyr::summarise(susie_pips = paste(round(snp_pip, 2), collapse = ","),
                       snps = paste(snp, collapse = ",")) %>%
  mutate(Peak = coa_peaks$Peak[queryHits])
)

mcols(p2g_gr) <- left_join(data.frame(mcols(p2g_gr)), tbl[, -1])

library(openxlsx)
write.xlsx(
  data.frame(mcols(p2g_gr[order(p2g_gr$NewCREs)])) %>%
    dplyr::select(Peak, LinkedGene, GeneScore, NewCREs, CandidateGenes, trait, snps, susie_pips),
  "output/asthma_candidate_risk_genes_43CREs.xlsx", quote = F)
```

```{r}
output <-
p2g_summary %>% 
  filter(Peak %in% as.character(GRanges(uniq_tbl)) &
           Gene %in% unlist(strsplit(uniq_tbl$E2G.genes, ","))) %>%
  group_by(Peak, Gene) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(CellType = paste(p2g_CellType, collapse = ",")) %>%
  mutate(NearestGene = gr_peaks_sub$nearestGene[match(Peak, gr_peaks_sub$Peak)])
 
out_gr <- GRanges(output$Peak)
mcols(out_gr) <- output[, -1]
```

Assessing our nominated genes vs. Ethan's using PoPs

```{r}
tbl <- readxl::read_xlsx("output/asthma_candidate_risk_genes_43CREs.xlsx")
e2g_genes <- unlist(lapply(tbl$LinkedGene, function(i){strsplit(i, ",")[[1]]}))
candi_genes <- unlist(lapply(cre_gr$nominated, function(i){strsplit(i, ",")[[1]]}))
pops_dir <- "data/pops/"
aoa_pops <- fread(paste0(pops_dir, "ukb_aoa/ukb_aoa.preds"))
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
mapGeneIDs <- function(query, query_type,
                        output_types) {

  mapped = AnnotationDbi::select(org.Hs.eg.db,
                  keys = query,
                  columns = output_types,
                  keytype = query_type)
  return(mapped)
}
mapped <- mapGeneIDs(unique(e2g_genes), "SYMBOL", "ENSEMBL")
idx = match(mapped[, "ENSEMBL"], aoa_pops$ENSGID)
pops_E2G <- data.frame(Gene = unique(e2g_genes)[!is.na(idx)],
                       pops = aoa_pops$PoPS_Score[idx[!is.na(idx)]])
  
mapped <- mapGeneIDs(unique(candi_genes), "SYMBOL", "ENSEMBL")
idx = match(mapped$ENSEMBL, aoa_pops$ENSGID)
pops_candi <- data.frame(Gene = unique(candi_genes)[!is.na(idx)],
                       pops = aoa_pops$PoPS_Score[idx[!is.na(idx)]])

t.test(pops_E2G$pops, pops_candi$pops)
# compare pops scores between
```

Making a pie plot to present the comparison results
```{r}

data <- data.frame(
  counts = c(6,1,4,3,11),
  category = c("Replicated",
               "Non-overlapping",
               "More refined",
               "Novel CREs",
               "Novel genes")) %>%
  mutate(percentage = counts/sum(counts))
pie <- ggplot(data,
              aes(x = "", y = percentage, 
                        fill = category)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) +
    coord_polar("y", start = 0) +
    theme_void() +  # Remove background and axes
    geom_text(aes(label = counts), 
              position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 8) +  # Adjust size as needed
    scale_fill_manual(
      
      values = c("#beaed4", "#ffff99","#386cb0", "#fdc086","#7fc97f"))+ 
    labs(fill = "") + 
    theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 18))# Legend title
pie
```

### More evidence to support our prioritized variants and genes

```{r}
library(openxlsx)
summary_tbl <- readxl::read_xlsx("../output/E2G_analysis/asthma_candidate_risk_genes_43CREs.xlsx")
pops_p2g <- readRDS("../data/plots/E2G_PoPs_by_genes.RDS")
eqtl_list <- readRDS("../output/E2G_analysis/natri2023_eQTLs.RDS")
gene_tbl <- 
  summary_tbl %>% 
    separate_rows(LinkedGene, sep = ",") %>%
    dplyr::select(-c(Peak, GeneScore, NewCREs, CandidateGenes, snps, susie_pips)) %>%
    distinct()
prior_tbl <- 
    summary_tbl %>%
    separate_rows(CandidateGenes,sep = ",") %>%
    filter(!is.na(CandidateGenes)) %>%
    dplyr::select(CandidateGenes, LinkedGene) %>%
    distinct()

gene_tbl$PoPS <- pops_p2g$pops[match(gene_tbl$LinkedGene, pops_p2g$SYMBOL)]
gene_tbl$ClosestGene <- gene_tbl$LinkedGene %in% gr_peaks_sub$nearestGene

eqtl_pairs <-
  lapply(prior_tbl$CandidateGenes, function(i) {
    pairs <-c()
    for(ct in names(eqtl_list)) {
      if(i %in% eqtl_list[[ct]]$targetGene) {
        rows = 
          data.frame(mcols(eqtl_list[[ct]])) %>% 
            filter(targetGene == i) %>%
              mutate(CandidateGenes = targetGene,
                     snps = rsid) %>%
              dplyr::select(rsid, targetGene)
        pairs <- rbind(pairs,
          data.frame(
            "CellType" = ct,
            rows))
      }
    }
    return(pairs)
  })
eqtl_pairs <- do.call(rbind, eqtl_genes[!sapply(eqtl_genes, is.null)])
gene_tbl$Lung_eGene <- gene_tbl$LinkedGene %in% eqtl_pairs$LinkedGene


# asthma eGene datasets
eGenes_set1 <- fread("~/cluster/projects/u19_multiomics/other_data/weilong/TableS5_1_asthma-risk-genes_ALOFT__TableS12.txt.gz")
eGenes_set2 <- fread("~/cluster/projects/u19_multiomics/other_data/weilong/TableS5_2_asthma-risk-genes_GTEx__TableS13.txt.gz")
eGenes_combined <- rbind(
  data.frame(study = "ALOFT", eGenes_set1),
  data.frame(study = "GTEx", eGenes_set2)
)
mapping <- 
  mapGeneIDs(eGenes_combined$gene, 
             query_type  = "ENSEMBL", 
             output_types = "SYMBOL")
eGenes_combined$eGenes <- 
  mapping$SYMBOL[match(eGenes_combined$gene, mapping$ENSEMBL)]

eGenes_combined %>% filter(symbol %in% gene_tbl$LinkedGene)

gene_tbl$Asthma_eGene <- 
  gene_tbl$LinkedGene %in% eGenes_combined$eGenes[eGenes_combined$study == "ALOFT"]

library(openxlsx)
write.xlsx(gene_tbl %>% distinct(),
   "../output/tables/scE2G_predicted_target_genes.xlsx", quote = F)

```
putative causal genes (PCGs) for asthma risk. The PCGs are defined as those with an FDR < 10% from INTACT. 
```{r}
riskGenes_set1 <- fread("~/cluster/projects/u19_multiomics/other_data/weilong/TableS5_1_asthma-risk-genes_ALOFT__TableS12.txt.gz")
riskGenes_set2 <- fread("~/cluster/projects/u19_multiomics/other_data/weilong/TableS5_2_asthma-risk-genes_GTEx__TableS13.txt.gz")
riskGenes_combined <- unique(
    c(riskGenes_set1$symbol[riskGenes_set1$FDR_intact < 0.1],
      riskGenes_set2$symbol[riskGenes_set1$FDR_intact < 0.1])
    )
aloft_genes <- riskGenes_set1$symbol[riskGenes_set1$FDR_intact < 0.1]
gtex_genes <- riskGenes_set1$symbol[riskGenes_set1$FDR_intact < 0.1]

random_genes <- do.call(rbind, random_genes)

EnrichmentTest(var1 = unique(gene_tbl$LinkedGene),
               var2 = unique(aloft_genes),
               bkg = union(gene_tbl$LinkedGene, random_genes$SYMBOL))
```

### barplot to compare PoPs across methods

```{r}
library(ggnewscale)
gginput <-
  gene_tbl %>% mutate(PreviousEvidence = PreviousEvidence >= 0.95) %>%
  filter(linkedGenes %in% c("IL15RA", "IL2RA", "PFKFB3", "PRKCQ",
                            "LRRC32", "CXCR5", "ERBB3", "IKZF4",
                            "SMAD3", "RAD50", "CEBPA", "TCF7", "IL4", "RORC")) %>%
  na.replace(0) %>%
  mutate(RelevanceToAsthma = case_when(
    linkedGenes %in% c("IL4", "IL2RA", "PRKCQ") ~ 3,
    linkedGenes %in% c("IL15RA", "LRRC32", "SMAD3", "RORC") ~ 2,
    linkedGenes %in% c("PFKFB3", "CXCR5", "IKZF4", "ERBB3",
                       "RAD50", "CEBPA", "TCF7") ~ 1)) %>%
  pivot_longer(2:5, names_to = "Features", values_to = "Values")

p_ranks <-
  ggplot(gginput %>% filter(Features %in% c("PreviousEvidence")),
         aes(y = factor(linkedGenes,levels = gene_tbl$linkedGenes[order(gene_tbl$PoPs)]),
             x = Features,
             fill = as.character(Values))) + 
    ylab("") + xlab("") + 
    geom_tile() + 
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("0" = "grey90", "1" = "black")) + #, name = "ClosestGene") + 
    #scale_fill_viridis_b() + 
    new_scale_fill() +
    geom_tile(data = gginput[gginput$Features == "PoPs", ],
              aes(x = Features, 
                  y = factor(linkedGenes,levels = gene_tbl$linkedGenes[order(gene_tbl$PoPs)]),
                  fill = Values)) + 
    scale_fill_viridis_b() + 
    new_scale_fill() + 
    geom_tile(data = gginput[gginput$Features == "RelevanceToAsthma", ],
              aes(x = Features, 
                  y = factor(linkedGenes,levels = gene_tbl$linkedGenes[order(gene_tbl$PoPs)]),
                  fill = factor(Values))) + 
    scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "A", 
                         name = "Relevance",
                         labels = c("low", "medium", "high")) +
    scale_x_discrete(
      labels = c("PoPs" = "PoPS", 
                 "PreviousEvidence" = "Previous\nEvidence",
                 "ClosestGene" = "Closest\nGene",
                 "RelevanceToAsthma" = "Asthma\nRelevance")) + 
    theme_pub(base_size = 13)

```
